</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:12pt;padding-left:114.75pt;padding-right:114.75pt;text-align:center"><font id="ibf38e8b5fb6e4d5994971c79faf7a041"></font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">Article 2</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%;padding-left:23.28pt"><br><br>PREMISES, TERM, RENT</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;padding-left:49.5pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt"><font id="i9c9f5e673a074ff3ae0d69a594107b03"></font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Section 38.1</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%;padding-left:30.39pt">Lease of Premises</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">.  Subject to the terms of this Lease, Landlord leases to Tenant and Tenant leases from Landlord the Premises for the Term.  In addition, Landlord grants to Tenant the right to use, on a non-exclusive basis and in common with other tenants, the Common Areas.  </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;padding-left:49.5pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt"><font id="i83f013320a734f4a8a7f970e1f5fbfd9"></font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Section 38.2</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%;padding-left:30.39pt">Commencement Date</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">.  (a)  Landlord and Tenant acknowledge that effective as of the Effective Date, this Lease shall be a binding obligation of Landlord and Tenant irrespective of whether the Commencement Date has occurred.  The Term of this Lease shall commence on the Commencement Date and, unless sooner terminated or extended as hereinafter provided, shall end on the Expiration Date.  Except as otherwise expressly provided in this Lease, if Landlord does not tender possession of the Premises to Tenant on or before any specified date, for any reason whatsoever, Landlord shall not be liable for any damage thereby, this Lease shall not be void or voidable thereby, the Term shall not commence until the occurrence of the Commencement Date and the same shall not affect any obligations of Tenant hereunder.  Except as otherwise expressly provided in this Lease, there shall be no postponement of the Commencement Date (or the Rent Commencement Date) for (i) any delay in the delivery of possession of the Premises which results from Tenant Delay or (ii) any delay by Landlord in the performance of the Post-Turnover Work and any Punch List Items relating to Landlord&#8217;s Premises Work, subject to the terms of this Lease.  The provisions of this </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Section 2.2(a)</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%"> are </font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">7</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:8pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">1930820.10 29086-0006-000</font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:72pt;width:100%"><div><font><br></font></div></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;padding-left:49.5pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">intended to constitute &#8220;an express provision to the contrary&#8221; within the meaning of Section 223-a of the New York Real Property Law or any successor Requirement. </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%"> </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:72pt"><font id="i760929f5c16b49c9a792cdbfee68ab8d"></font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">(a)</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%;padding-left:23.78pt">Landlord shall send Tenant a notice not later than 30 days prior to the date when Landlord reasonably anticipates delivering the Premises to Tenant with the Turnover Work Substantially Complete.  Landlord shall give notice to Tenant (each, a &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Landlord&#8217;s SC Notice</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;) on or before the date which is 10 Business Days prior to the date (the &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Anticipated Commencement Date</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;) the Turnover Work is Substantially Complete and the date (the &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Anticipated Post-Turnover Work SC Date</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;&#59; the Anticipated Commencement Date and&#47;or the Anticipated Post-Turnover Work SC Date, as applicable, the &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">SC Date</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;) the Post-Turnover Work is Substantially Complete.  Upon delivery of an Landlord&#8217;s SC Notice, such Landlord&#8217;s Premises Work shall be deemed Substantially Complete on the applicable SC Date and, with respect to the Turnover Work only, the Premises shall be deemed delivered to Tenant on the Anticipated Commencement Date subject to Tenant&#8217;s right to dispute the same as provided below in in this </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Section 2.2(b)</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">.  On or within 5 Business Days after the applicable SC Date, Landlord and Tenant shall jointly inspect the Premises (an &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">SC Inspection</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;).  Within 5 Business Days after any such SC Inspection, Tenant shall send Landlord a notice (each, a &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Tenant&#8217;s SC Notice</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;) stating whether or not Tenant agrees that such Landlord&#8217;s Premises Work is Substantially Complete (and if Tenant fails to give Landlord such notice prior to the expiration of such 5-Business Day period, then Tenant shall be deemed to have agreed that such Landlord&#8217;s Premises Work is Substantially Complete).  If Tenant concludes that such Landlord&#8217;s Premises Work is not Substantially Complete, then Tenant shall specify and list in reasonable detail in Tenant&#8217;s SC Notice all items asserted to be incomplete or unsatisfactorily completed (excluding the Post-Turnover Work (with respect to the Turnover Work only) and Punch List Items relating to Landlord&#8217;s Premises Work) (the &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Incomplete Work</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;).  If Tenant concludes that such Landlord&#8217;s Premises Work is Substantially Complete, Tenant shall include in Tenant&#8217;s SC Notice, a punch list setting forth any Punch List Items relating to such Landlord&#8217;s Premises Work (other than the Post-Turnover Work (with respect to the Turnover Work only) (and if Tenant fails to give Landlord such punch list prior to the expiration of such 5-Business Day period, then (a) such Landlord&#8217;s Premises Work shall be deemed to be Substantially Complete on the date set forth in the applicable Landlord&#8217;s SC Notice and (b) there shall be no Punch List Items relating to such Landlord&#8217;s Premises Work. If such LEED certification is obtained, Tenant shall endeavor (without material cost to Tenant) to comply with all required guidelines and conditions of the Building LEED so as to not adversely affect such LEED status but failure to do so by Tenant shall not be a default by Tenant under this Lease and Tenant shall have no obligation to design the Initial Installations (or any other Alterations), or apply, for any LEED certification unless required by applicable Requirements. (a)<font id="i34f8acb0f6294a199f75ccbab2766d44"></font>  Tenant shall have the right to renew (&#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Renewal Option</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;) the Term for the Renewal Premises (as hereinafter defined) for up to 2 renewal terms of either 10 or 5 years with respect to each such renewal term (as applicable each a &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Renewal Term</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;), commencing on the day after the Initial Expiration Date for the first Renewal Term and on the day after the expiration of the first Renewal Term for the second Renewal Term (as applicable for such Renewal Term, the &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Renewal Term Commencement Date</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;) and ending on the day immediately preceding either the 5th or the 10th anniversary, as the case may be, of the particular Renewal Term Commencement Date (as applicable), unless the Renewal Term shall sooner terminate pursuant to any of the terms of this Lease or otherwise.  Any such applicable Renewal Term shall commence only if (i)&#160;Tenant notifies Landlord (&#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Exercise Notice</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;) of Tenant&#8217;s exercise of such renewal right not later than 22 months prior to the Initial Expiration Date for the first Renewal Term, or 22 months prior to the expiration date of the first Renewal Term for the second Renewal Term&#59; and (ii)&#160;at the time of the exercise of such right and immediately prior to the applicable Renewal Term Commencement Date in question, (A) no Material Default exists&#59; and (B)&#160;Tenant occupies at least 70% of the Premises (and at least 70% of the Renewal Premises).  </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%;text-decoration:underline">Time is of the essence</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%"> with respect to the giving of each Exercise Notice. (ii) Tenant shall have no further right to renew the Term beyond the expiration of the second Renewal Term&#59; (iii) the Base Tax Year shall be the Tax Year during which the applicable Renewal Term Commencement Date occurs&#59; and (A) the Base PILOT Amount shall be the PILOT Amount (or, if the PILOT Cessation Date shall have occurred, the Taxes) for such Tax Year&#59; and (B) the Base Impositions Amount shall be the Impositions for such Tax Year&#59; (iv) no Additional Tax Payment shall be payable during the applicable Renewal Term&#59; (v) the Base Expense Year shall be calendar year in which the applicable Renewal Term Commencement Date occurs&#59; (vi) Tenant shall be entitled to any Market Concessions that are included as part of the determination of the Fair Market Value for the Renewal Premises for the applicable Renewal Term&#59; (vii) if the Renewal Premises is less than the then entire Premises, (A) Tenant&#8217;s Proportionate Share shall be reduced to a fraction (expressed as a percentage), the numerator of which is the rentable square footage of the Renewal Premises, and the denominator of which is the Agreed Area of Building&#59; and (B) any reference to &#8220;the Premises&#8221; shall be deemed to mean the Renewal Premises&#59; (viii) the applicable Renewal Term shall be added to and become part of the Term&#59; (ix)&#160;any reference to the &#8220;Term&#8221;, the &#8220;term of this Lease&#8221; or any similar expression shall be deemed to include such Renewal Term&#59; and (x)&#160;the expiration of the applicable Renewal Term shall become the Expiration Date.  Any termination, cancellation or surrender of the entire interest of Tenant under </font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">105</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:8pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">1930820.10 29086-0006-000</font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:72pt;width:100%"><div><font><br></font></div></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">this Lease at any time during the Term shall terminate any unexercised rights of renewal of Tenant hereunder.  </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:72pt"><font id="i32216f7f91d44e14979d4fc9182e447a"></font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">(c)</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%;padding-left:24.34pt">For the purposes of this </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Article 29</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">, the term &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Renewal Premises</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221; and (i) at Tenant&#8217;s election, at least one or more entire full floors of the then Premises, which floors are contiguous to each other, beginning with the bottom of the then Premises&#59; plus (ii) at Tenant&#8217;s election, other entire floors of the then Premises which are not contiguous to any other floors of the Premises&#59; plus (iii) at Tenant&#8217;s election, any partial floor of the Premises contiguous to a full floor of the Premises being renewed, but not less than the entirety of any such partial floor.  Subject to the foregoing, Tenant shall include a description of the Renewal Premises in the Exercise Notice and Tenant&#8217;s failure to do so shall be deemed an election by Tenant to renew the Term in respect of the entirety of the premises then demised hereunder.  In addition, Tenant shall designate the term of the Renewal Term in the Exercise Notice in question and Tenant&#8217;s failure to do so shall be deemed an election by Tenant of 5-year Renewal Term.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:72pt"><font id="i932e18823ff444bbaa91d78a204cf7f7"></font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">(d)</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%;padding-left:23.78pt">Landlord shall send to Tenant an FMV Notice for the Renewal Premises for the Renewal Term at least 120 days prior to the commencement of the applicable Renewal Term.  </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;padding-left:49.5pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt"><font id="i10d56be3bf734a05908129e54467ad25"></font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Section 38.2</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%;padding-left:30.39pt">Fair Market Value Determination</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">.  (a)<font id="i90eb23db2a4947c292f6545b70470856"></font>  &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Fair Market Value</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221; shall mean the fixed annual rent, determined as of the commencement of the FMV Term that a willing lessee would pay and a willing lessor would accept for the FMV Space for the FMV Term in the Building and&#47;or Comparable Buildings at such commencement of the FMV Term, each party acting prudently and under no compulsion to lease, taking into account all relevant factors, including, without limitation, any terms expressly provided herein for the leasing of the FMV Space for the FMV Term (</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%;text-decoration:underline">e.g.</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">, adjustments to any base years, the granting of any Market Concessions, responsibility for brokerage commission, and the delivery condition of the FMV Space, if so specified).   </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:72pt"><font id="ib80794ec841f442587e4f76588648cb8"></font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">(b)</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%;padding-left:23.78pt">If Tenant disputes Landlord&#8217;s determination of Fair Market Value, the dispute shall be resolved by arbitration as provided in </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Section&#160;29.3</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">.  If the Fixed Rent payable during the applicable FMV Term is not determined prior to the commencement thereof, Tenant shall pay Fixed Rent in an amount equal to the average of the Fair Market Value for the FMV Space as determined by both Landlord and Tenant (the &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Interim Rent</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;).  Upon final determination of the Fixed Rent for the applicable FMV Space for the FMV Term, Tenant shall commence paying such Fixed Rent as so determined, and within 30 days after such determination Tenant shall pay any deficiency in prior payments of Fixed Rent or, if the Fixed Rent as so determined shall be less than the Interim Rent, Tenant shall be entitled to a credit against the next succeeding installments of Fixed Rent in an amount equal to the difference between each installment of Interim Rent and the Fixed Rent as so determined which should have been paid for such installment until the total amount of the over payment has been recouped.  </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;padding-left:49.5pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt"><font id="i6e463a66934c413586d7a95ac086dcb2"></font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Section 38.3</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%;padding-left:30.39pt">Arbitration</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">.  If Tenant disputes Landlord&#8217;s determination of Fair Market Value pursuant to </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Section&#160;29.2(b)</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">, Tenant shall give notice to Landlord of such dispute and demand arbitration within 30 days after delivery of the applicable FMV Notice.  Failure on the part of Tenant to make the timely and proper demand for such arbitration shall constitute a waiver of the right thereto and the Fair Market Value of the FMV Space for the applicable FMV Term shall be as set forth in the FMV Notice in respect thereof.  Such dispute shall be determined by arbitration in accordance with the then prevailing Expedited Procedures of the Arbitration Rules for the Real Estate Industry of the American Arbitration Association (&#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">AAA</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;) or its successor for arbitration of commercial disputes, except that the arbitration shall not be administered by the AAA and the rules shall be modified as follows&#58;</font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">106</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:8pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">1930820.10 29086-0006-000</font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:72pt;width:100%"><div><font><br></font></div></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:72pt"><font id="i13cdd04a4db442efb1268d0cca0206a8"></font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">(a)</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%;padding-left:23.78pt">In its demand for arbitration Tenant shall specify the name and address of the person to act as the arbitrator on Tenant&#8217;s behalf.  If Tenant fails to timely identify its arbitrator by notice to Landlord, provided such failure continues for 5 Business Days after Landlord delivers notice to Tenant indicating that Tenant has failed to notify Landlord of its arbitrator, then the arbitrator appointed by Landlord shall be the arbitrator to determine the Fair Market Value of the Renewal Premises for the applicable Renewal Term.  The arbitrator shall be an MAI appraiser with at least 10 years full-time experience appraising the fair market value of first-class office space in the Borough of Manhattan, City of New York, New York.  Failure on the part of Tenant to make the timely and proper demand for such arbitration shall constitute a waiver of the right thereto and the Fixed Rent for the FMV Space for the applicable FMV Term shall be as set forth in the FMV Notice in respect thereof.  Within 10 Business Days after the service of the demand for arbitration, Landlord shall give notice to Tenant specifying the name and address of the person designated by Landlord to act as arbitrator on its behalf, which arbitrator shall be similarly qualified.  If Landlord fails to notify Tenant of the appointment of its arbitrator within such 10 Business Day period, and such failure continues for 5 Business Days after Tenant delivers a second notice to Landlord, then the arbitrator appointed by Tenant shall be the arbitrator to determine the Fair Market Value of the FMV Space for the applicable FMV Term.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:72pt"><font id="i26e672871f9847a3b8bd08310ca32f05"></font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">(b)</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%;padding-left:23.78pt">If 2 arbitrators are chosen pursuant to </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Section 29.3(a)</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">, the arbitrators so chosen shall meet within 10 Business Days after the second arbitrator is appointed and shall seek to reach agreement on Fair Market Value of the FMV Space for the applicable FMV Term.  If within 30 Business Days after the 2nd arbitrator is appointed the 2 arbitrators are unable to reach agreement on Fair Market Value of the FMV Space for the applicable FMV Term, then the 2 arbitrators shall appoint a 3rd arbitrator, who shall be a competent and impartial person with qualifications similar to those required of the first 2 arbitrators pursuant to </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Section 29.3(a)</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">.  If they are unable to agree upon such appointment within 5 Business Days after expiration of such 20 Business Day period, the 3rd arbitrator shall be selected by the parties themselves.  If the parties do not agree on the 3rd arbitrator within 5 Business Days after expiration of the foregoing 5 Business Day period, then either party, on behalf of both, may request appointment of such a qualified person by the AAA.  The 3rd arbitrator shall decide the dispute, if it has not been previously resolved, by following the procedures set forth in </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Section 29.3(c)</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">.  Each party shall pay the fees and expenses of its respective arbitrator and both shall share the fees and expenses of the 3rd arbitrator.  Attorneys&#8217; fees and expenses of counsel and of witnesses for the respective parties shall be paid by the respective party engaging such counsel or calling such witnesses.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:72pt"><font id="i074ca84050914fe08e6dc341efd2acbb"></font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">(c)</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%;padding-left:24.34pt">Fair Market Value for the FMV Space for the applicable FMV Term shall be fixed by the 3rd arbitrator in accordance with the following procedures.  Within 5 Business Days following the appointment of the 3rd arbitrator, each of the arbitrators selected by the parties shall deliver to such 3rd arbitrator a sealed envelope stating, in writing, his or her determination of the Fair Market Value of the FMV Space for the applicable FMV Term supported by the reasons therefor.  The 3rd arbitrator shall conduct hearings within 90 days after being appointed and following such hearings, shall, within 30 days, select which of the 2 proposed determinations most closely approximates his or her determination of Fair Market Value of the FMV Space for the applicable FMV Term.  The 3rd arbitrator shall have no right to propose a middle ground or any modification of either of the 2 proposed determinations.  The determination he or she chooses as that most closely approximating his or her determination of the Fair Market Value of the FMV Space for the applicable FMV Term shall constitute the decision of the 3rd arbitrator and shall be final and binding upon the parties.  The 3rd arbitrator shall render the decision in writing with counterpart copies to each party.  The 3rd arbitrator shall have no power to add to or modify the provisions of this Lease.  Promptly following receipt of the 3rd arbitrator&#8217;s decision, the parties shall enter into an amendment to this Lease in form and substance reasonably acceptable to Landlord and Tenant evidencing the lease of such FMV Space for the applicable FMV Term, but the failure of the parties to do so shall not affect the effectiveness of the final determination thereof.</font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">107</font></div><div><font or her successor shall be appointed by him or her, but in the case of the 3rd arbitrator, his or her successor shall be appointed in the same manner as that set forth herein with respect to the appointment of the original 3rd arbitrator.  </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:12pt;padding-left:114.75pt;padding-right:114.75pt;text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Section 38.1</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">.  (a)<font id="i7370f59dcc9044f68a8ad44779a12ce2"></font>  At any time during the Term, prior to the last 48 months of the then Term (as the same may be extended) (the 1st day of such last 48 months of the Term being the &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">48-Month Outside Date</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;), Landlord proposes to lease any Offered Space (as defined below) (on a full floor or partial floor basis) which is (or Landlord anticipates will be) Available prior to the 48-Month Outside Date, Landlord shall deliver notice thereof to Tenant (an &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Offered Space Notice</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;), which Offered Space Notice shall set forth (i) the Offered Space in question (including, with respect to any portions of the Offered Space which are then separately demised, a floor plan thereof), (ii) Landlord&#8217;s determination of the Fair Market Value for such Offered Space for the remainder of the then Term (and the same shall be deemed to be an FMV Notice)&#59; (iii) the rentable square footage of such Offered Space&#59; (iv) Tenant&#8217;s Proportionate Share in respect of such Offered Space&#59; and (v) the date Landlord anticipates that such Offered Space will become Available (the &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Anticipated Offered Space Commencement Date</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;), subject to the terms below.  Landlord shall provide Tenant any Offered Space Notice (A) no later than 6 months prior to the Anticipated Offered Space Commencement Date, and (B)(I) no sooner than 15 months prior to the Anticipated Offered Space Commencement Date in respect of Offered Space consisting of one full floor or less, or (II) 20 months prior to the Anticipated Offered Space Commencement Date in respect of Offered Space consisting of more than one full floor.  Landlord may update the Anticipated Offered Space Commencement Date on notice to Tenant, from time to time&#59; provided that if the updated Anticipated Offer Space Commencement Date (the &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Updated Anticipated OS Commencement Date</font><font applicable Offered Space Notice (the &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Original Anticipated OS Commencement Date</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;), (AA) the Updated Anticipated Offered Space Commencement Date shall be no sooner than 6 months after the date of such notice or (BB) if sooner than 6 months after the date of such notice, at Tenant&#8217;s option, the Offered Space Commencement Date shall be no sooner than the Original Anticipated OS Commencement Date&#59; or (2) later than the Original Anticipated OS Commencement Date, (AA) the Updated Anticipated OS Commencement Date shall be no later than 3 months after the Original Anticipated OS Commencement Date, or (BB) if later than 3 months after the Original Anticipated OS Commencement Date, Tenant shall have the right to rescind the Acceptance Notice for such Offered Space within 30 days after such notice.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:72pt"><font id="i59e815af274448d9ab7ed61edddb9f6f"></font><font portion of the Offered Space set forth in the Offered Space Notice, (ii) one or more full floors of such Offered Space, or (iii) if the Offered Space Notice states that Landlord is willing to accept a third party bona fide offer for less than a full floor of the Offered Space (as more particularly described in </font><font applicable Offered Space Notice, in either case, upon the terms and conditions set forth in this </font><font for purposes hereof, &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">negotiating</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221; means, at least, Landlord or such Person has delivered to the other a proposal, a proposed term sheet or letter of intent or other similar writing expressing a desire to enter into a lease for such Offered Space), Landlord shall be obligated to re-offer such Offered Space to Tenant in accordance with the provisions of </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Section 30.1(a)</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%"> prior to Landlord entering into a lease with a third party with respect to such Offered Space.  In the event of such re-offer, Tenant shall have the right to accept such offer in accordance with the provisions of </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Section 30.1(b)</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;padding-left:49.5pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt"><font id="i3fb3f983bfdc4534b1bcb9661a1701c1"></font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Section 38.2</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%;padding-left:30.39pt">Conditions to Exercise</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">.  On the date the applicable Acceptance Notice is delivered to Landlord and on the applicable Offered Space Commencement Date, (a) no Material Default exists&#59; and (b) Tenant occupies at least 70% of the then Premises.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;padding-left:49.5pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt"><font id="ib6366931200145f8897f92fc5f9d4ad8"></font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Section 38.3</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%;padding-left:30.39pt">Incorporation of Offered Space</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">.  Effective as of the date on which Landlord delivers vacant possession of the Offered Space in question to Tenant in the condition required in </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">clause (d)</font><font Landlord shall be responsible for any structural repairs to the Terraces in order to comply with applicable Requirements or as otherwise required, which structural repairs shall include the underlying roof membrane, waterproofing and parapet walls, and shall be at Landlord&#8217;s sole cost (but subject to recoupment pursuant to </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Article 7</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%"> above to the extent permitted thereunder), unless the necessity for such structural repairs arises out of the specific manner of use of the Terraces by Tenant, the negligent or wrongful acts or omissions (where there is a duty to act) of any Tenant Party, Alterations made by Tenant, or the breach of this Lease by Tenant, in which case such structural repairs shall be at Tenant&#8217;s sole cost and expense of Landlord&#8217;s out-of-pocket costs therefor.  Without limiting the generality of the foregoing provisions of this </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Section 33.1(a)</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">, Tenant shall obtain all permits and licenses required by any Governmental Authority with respect to Tenant&#8217;s use of the Terraces to the extent the necessity for such permits and&#47;or licenses arises out of the specific manner of use of the Terraces by Tenant (as opposed to the mere use and occupancy of the Terraces), the negligent or wrongful acts or omissions (where there is a duty to act) of any Tenant Party, Alterations made by Tenant, or the breach of this Lease by Tenant, renew all such permits and licenses as and when required by applicable Requirements and pay promptly as and when due all taxes, license, permit and other fees or charges imposed in respect thereof.  Upon Tenant&#8217;s request, Landlord shall reasonably cooperate with Tenant in obtaining any permits, approvals or certificates required to be obtained by Tenant in connection with Tenant&#8217;s use of the Terraces (if the provisions of the applicable Requirement require that Landlord join in such application)&#59; provided that Tenant shall reimburse Landlord for Landlord&#8217;s out-of-pocket costs in connection therewith.  Tenant shall not alter the Terraces (except as hereinafter provided) or affix anything to the Terraces other than outdoor furniture and&#47;or other appropriate and related items approved by Landlord, and other than Alterations consented to by Landlord in accordance with </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Article 5</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">.  Such furniture and other appropriate and related items shall be maintained and secured so as to minimize any risk, in case of a windstorm or otherwise, of any property moving and causing injury or damage to persons or property.  Except for landscaping and furniture designated in the Tenant Design Guidelines attached hereto as </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Exhibit W</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%"> (as same may be reasonably modified from time to time, the &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Tenant Design Guidelines</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;), no such furniture or installations on the Terraces shall exceed the height of the parapet wall of the Terraces or be visible from the street. Landlord (a &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Contraction Option Notice</font><font months prior to the 10 Year Contraction Option Date, and (ii) with respect to the 15 Year Contraction Option, on or before the date which is (A) if the Contraction Space contains no more than one full floor, 18 months prior to the 15 Year Contraction Option Date, (B) if the Contraction Space contains more than one floor but less than 3 floors, 24 months prior to the 15 Year Contraction Option Date, and (C) if the Contraction Space contains 3 or more floors, 30 months prior to the 15 Year Contraction Option Date.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;padding-left:49.5pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt"><font id="ibbf9a0fa0ee243d8beb80e2502754e40"></font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Section 38.2</font><font (a) Tenant timely pays to Landlord the Contraction Payment when due and payable under this </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Article 38</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#59; and (b) within the 18-month period immediately preceding Tenant&#8217;s delivery of a Contraction Option Notice, Tenant shall not have validly delivered (i) an Acceptance Notice in respect of any Offered Space pursuant to </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Article 30</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">, or (ii) an Expansion Notice in respect of the Expansion Space pursuant to </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Article 37</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;padding-left:49.5pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt"><font id="i939a2d44e0354c168a59c36b4bd085ef"></font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Section 38.3</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%;padding-left:30.39pt">Contraction Payment</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">.  (a)<font id="ifde040f6493940529766eca17949cd39"></font>  The effectiveness of the exercise of any Contraction Option is conditioned upon Tenant&#8217;s payment to Landlord of an amount (the &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Contraction Payment</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;) equal to the then (as of the Contraction Option Date for the Contraction Space in Contribution and Bathroom Contribution allocable to the Contraction Space (determined on a per rentable square foot basis), (iii) cost of any free rent provided to Tenant hereunder allocable to the Contraction Space (determined on a per rentable square foot basis), and (iv) brokerage commissions, if any, paid or incurred by Landlord in connection with this Lease allocable to the Contraction Space (determined on a per rentable square foot basis), all of which amounts shall be amortized on a straight line basis over the term of this Lease with interest thereon at 6% per annum compounding monthly.  </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:72pt"><font id="i4c1f83caf9084709b56a244e8b1adad7"></font><font therefor (&#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Landlord&#8217;s Contraction Payment Estimate</font><font Subject to the provisions of this </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Section 38.3</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">.  If Tenant disputes Landlord&#8217;s Contraction Payment Estimate, Tenant shall give notice to Landlord of such dispute (&#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Tenant&#8217;s Contraction Payment Dispute </font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">123</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:8pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">1930820.10 29086-0006-000</font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:72pt;width:100%"><div><font><br></font></div></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Notice</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;) within 30 days after receipt of the applicable Landlord&#8217;s Contraction Payment Estimate (</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%;text-decoration:underline">time being of the essence</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">) and the dispute shall be resolved by arbitration pursuant to </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Article 36</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">. Until such dispute is resolved, Tenant shall pay to Landlord, within 30 days after receipt of Landlord&#8217;s Contraction Payment Estimate (or along with timely delivery of Tenant&#8217;s Contraction calculations with reasonable detail, of Tenant&#8217;s Contraction Payment Estimate.  </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:72pt"><font Obligor shall bear the burdens of proof and persuasion and shall provide evidence to the DCA no later than 45 days after its receipt of the LW Violation Notice.  The DCA shall then, on behalf of the City, the Agency and the Comptroller, make a good faith determination of whether the Asserted LW Violation exists based on the evidence provided by Obligor and deliver to Obligor a written statement of such determination in reasonable detail, which shall include a confirmation or modification of the Asserted LW Violation and Asserted Cure (such statement, a &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%;text-decoration:underline">LW Violation Initial Determination</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;). If no filing in a court of competent jurisdiction or for an administrative hearing is made to contest the LW Violation Initial Determination within 30 days after Obligor&#8217;s receipt thereof, then the LW Violation Initial Determination shall be deemed to be a &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%;text-decoration:underline">LW Violation Final Determination</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">&#8221;. On a non-holiday Wednesday, using either existing cameras or setting up task-specific cameras, recordings will be made of all calls entered and people flow to elevator cars.  Each unique waiting time will be measured from the (i) starting point&#58; the later of when a person is positioned mid elevator lobby (in the case where the turnstile provides &#8220;the call&#8221;) or after a person enters a call on the keypad within the elevator lobby.  In the case of a person not entering a call (because others have done so and the group are going to the same floors), then that start point shall be measured from the time that the person is positioned mid elevator lobby&#59; to the (ii) end point&#58; when the respective elevator car doors open.</font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">The average waiting time will then be calculated by dividing the sum of all individual waiting times over the performance period (60 minutes in the case of morning up-peak and 120 minutes in the case of midday two-way traffic) by the total minutes in that period (60 minutes in the case of morning up-peak and 120 minutes in the case of midday two-way traffic).</font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">N-1</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:8pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">1930820.10 29086-0006-000</font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:72pt;width:100%"><div><font><br></font></div></div><div style="margin-top:0.05pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:100%">In the event that TT is allocated 4 dedicated passenger cars, and one of the 4 cars is rendered inoperable during normal business hours, then LL shall unpartition the dispatch system through programming, so that all of the remaining cars operate as a single group as soon as reasonably possible. Tishman Speyer believes that an appropriately compensated and trained workforce is likely to deliver higher quality products and services, which in turn can directly contribute to both the success of individual property investments and the overall performance of the Tishman Speyer portfolio.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:8pt;margin-top:8pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:174%">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Tishman Speyer has developed this Responsible Contractor Policy (this &#8220;Policy&#8221;) in order to ensure that Contractors</font><font style="color:#ff0000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:700;line-height:174%"> </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:174%">understand the company&#8217;s commitment to responsible contracting.  This Policy will guide Tishman Speyer&#8217;s selection of independent contractors who provide various building operations services and construction services to real estate properties located in the United States of America.  Implementation of this Policy will allow Tishman Speyer to put into practice its beliefs and goals with respect to responsible contracting.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:9pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">2.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Approved and Responsible Contractors</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:8pt;margin-top:8pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:174%">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;All contractors providing services to Tishman Speyer must satisfy certain essential prerequisites. Only contractors that satisfy these core criteria (&#8220;Approved Contractors&#8221;) can be listed on Tishman Speyer&#8217;s Approved Contractor List.  </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:8pt;margin-top:8pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:9pt;font-weight:400;line-height:174%">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Through the implementation of this Policy, Tishman Speyer plans wherever possible to utilize Approved Contractors who also are Responsible Contractors.  Responsible Contractors are contractors who Tishman Speyer reasonably believes (a) pay workers fair wages and benefits&#59; (b) utilize fair employment practices (including compliance with all applicable statutes and regulations)&#59; (c) provide a safe workplace&#59; and (d) provide training and&#47;or apprenticeships where such practices are prevalent in the local market.  &#8220;Fair wages and benefits&#8221; for purposes of this Policy shall be determined by Tishman Speyer in its reasonable judgment, taking into consideration such factors as federal, state, and local laws&#59; local practices and prevailing wages&#59; and past experience on comparable operating properties and construction projects (based on the nature of the property or project, the job or trade classification, and the scope and complexity of services provided).</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:6pt"><font exercises its Pre-CD Contraction Option to reduce its Agreed Area of the Office Premises by 16,000 RSF to a revised Agreed Area of the Office Premises of 173,226 RSF, the January 1, 2023 NPV of the
